mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth declines by > 2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, measured by the month-over-month change in the retail and food services sales index, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS m/m growth declines by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as credit conditions tighten.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is above 6%, it signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth < -10% and UNRATE > 6%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs month-over-month and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS m/m growth < -100,000 and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS m/m growth < -100,000 and UNRATE is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflation scare that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher future rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
